source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Requester asks independent random complex photographic keyword qualification using the attached image. Agent-owned random direction: one fictional adult woman coasting through the final lap of a nearly closed roller rink, seen by her rink-edge friend as she turns back. WHO: portrait-guided face and short bob with an open, fleeting smile. WHERE: return counter and stacked skates signal the end of the evening. HOW: a nearby friend catches her full-body glide at chest height. WHY NOW: momentum carries her toward returning the skates after the music stops. The three authorial test effects are hard direct flash, a coherent slow-sync movement trace and shadow-local digital luma/chroma noise; these are advisory testing choices, not requester-prescribed scene details. Sensual=1 supports ordinary warmth and presence through her glance and satin drape; fetish=0, surreal=0 and creativity=1 keep the scene grounded. The scene, wardrobe, action and physical realization remain agent-owned within open dimensions.
subject: One fictional adult woman whose visible face and short dark bob are guided by the supplied portrait; no identity claim or body inference.
setting: Almost empty night roller rink beside its skate-return counter.
event: A candid photographic moment, realized by the agent as the woman gliding left to right on her last slow lap and turning toward the friend taking the photograph.
visual_priorities: The returning glance and smile connect the skater with the off-frame friend taking the picture.
Staggered grounded quad skates, bent knees and the return counter make the last slow glide legible.
Hard frontal flash freezes a sharp subject while a single coherent trailing exposure follows her moving sleeve and wheels.
Shadow-local luma texture and sparse green-magenta speckles distinguish digital noise from brightness or material detail.
baseline_prompt_en: A photographic scene of a fictional adult woman in a candid moment at an almost empty night roller rink beside the skate-return counter. Her face and hair are guided by the attached portrait: a short dark bob with fine parted bangs, a softly rounded facial contour, dark eyes and naturally pink lips. She glides left to right through her last slow lap, turning her head toward her rink-edge friend who is taking this photograph. A small, unguarded smile and the loose swing of her open slate satin blouson make the farewell feel close and spontaneous; an ivory fitted knit tank and dark tapered trousers belong naturally to the evening. Both quad-skate wheel sets meet the smooth floor, feet slightly staggered beneath softly bent knees, with her left arm held loosely outward for balance. The return counter and stacked rental skates mark where her glide is carrying her. Photograph her full body from nearby at chest height, with her face large enough to read and both skates inside the frame. The main impression is a compact-digital direct-flash snapshot: hard frontal flash makes a crisp bright edge on her cheek and jacket folds, with a short dark floor shadow behind her skates and a dimmer rink. Slow-sync flash freezes one sharp body while a faint continuous exposure trail follows her moving sleeve and wheels toward screen left; fixed rails and counter edges stay still. Fine digital luma noise and scattered tiny green-magenta chroma speckles are visibly strongest across the dark wall and shaded jacket folds, fading into the bright face. Keep skin texture, satin reflections and floor contact readable.
